resources.string: The last 200 runs stay on this phone. The report contains measurements and rep counts, not video, body landmarks or account details.

Test complete. Share the report to send the measurements and rep counts.
Set the phone at knee height, 2–3 m away to start. Use even light and leave room above the head and below the feet.
Record one countermovement jump in the Camera app at normal speed. Stand still before and after landing. Pick that clip here; do not reuse it for another trial.
Clip measured %1$.1f fps, not the selected %2$d fps. Check the camera setting and pick again.
No 60 fps option: pick a 30 fps clip
Face the camera. Start and end standing straight. Count your own repetitions without relying on the on-screen tally. Use the live coach for at least one set and a recorded clip for at least one set.
How many repetitions did you do?
Enter a whole number of repetitions.
Delete all local diagnostics and reset the guided phone test?
